questions.value: No single trigger event noted; improvement over last 6 months after removing identified irritant foods via trial-and-error.

questions.value: Not time-of-day dependent; symptoms correlate with digestion (when food reaches colon). Onset ranges from ~5 hours up to ~24–28 hours after eating.
